design_direction.rationale: People choose a dentist on trust and reviews, not on photos of a waiting room, and with only 3 usable images the site should open on the rating and review count rather than a weak photo-led first screen. A calm, clinical-but-warm mood with a single blue accent (sampled from their own photography) reads as competent and reassuring, and closing on a real patient's words does more work than another stock-feeling image.
design_direction.signature_why: A single warm patient review set large does more to calm a nervous new patient than another stock photo of teeth ever could.

blocks.heading: Prime Dental all began with Dr. Le.
blocks.text: Dr. Le attended the University of Texas at Austin for his undergraduate education, earning a Bachelor of Science degree in Biochemistry. He continued to Baylor College of Dentistry, where he received his Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) degree in 2005. With the many advancements in dental technology and products over the years, Dr. Le’s goal has always been to offer his patients the most effective and efficient care possible.

blocks.heading: That’s when Prime Dental was born!
blocks.text: The team at Prime Dental began to grow as Dr. Le endeavored to deliver an unparalleled dental experience by challenging the status quo of what has been part of the industry norms for the profession.

blocks.heading: Why do we do what we do?
blocks.text: Our team works tirelessly to change people’s lives in a positive way. The Prime Dental team gets to wake up every day knowing that they will make a difference in someone’s life. Whether they are giving a patient back their smile, or helping to alleviate a patient’s discomfort, dentistry is an ever-rewarding profession. We value integrity, teamwork, clinical excellence, and we work hard on a daily basis to deliver that to our beloved patients. We are a group of dental providers who truly care about our patients’ experiences. This means quality care is given and our standards never fall. To put it simply – we simply care about what we do.

blocks.heading: Dr. An Q. Le
blocks.text: Dr. Le – Dentistry is a wonderful profession because it allows me to change people’s lives in a positive way. It is very satisfying to wake up everyday and know that I will make a difference in someone’s life, whether I am giving a patient back a smile they have lost or helping to alleviate a patient’s discomfort. I am very thankful for the wonderful relationships I have built with my patients over the years and I hope to make Crystal Creek Dental your dental home. Originally from San Antonio, TX, I now reside in Allen with my wife, Helena, and our three children, Braylen, Brianna, and Brennan. I love spending time with my family, and when I have free time you can find me in the kitchen cooking or backyard bbqing.

blocks.heading: Dr. Kennedy
blocks.text: Dr. Kennedy is originally from Oklahoma and grew up as an army brat moving between Oklahoma and Kansas. He proudly attended the University of Oklahoma for both his undergraduate and Dental degrees. He has practiced in the Oklahoma City and Kansas City metro areas before coming to Dallas as his forever home. Dr. Kennedy’s main focus is to practice thorough and pain-free dentistry in a caring, fun, and gentle environment. His motto is to “Do the right thing for the right reason”, and he strives to live by that every day.

blocks.heading: Dr. Kruti Khara
blocks.text: Dr. Kruti Khara is a native of the DFW area and grew up in Plano, TX where she graduated from Plano Senior High School. She then went on to get her undergraduate?degree from the University of Texas at Austin and her D.D.S. from Baylor College of Dentistry in Dallas, TX. Dr. Khara has extensive experience in all areas of dentistry and her main focus is providing comprehensive care in a relaxing environment. She is very passionate about educating patients about their overall oral health and changing their lives for the better. Dr. Khara uses state of the art technology to preserve healthy teeth and gums, alleviate oral pain and create beautiful smiles. She believes in building long lasting relationships with her patients. Dr. Khara also enjoys giving back to the community by participating in events such as Dentistry from the Heart and community health fairs. Dr. Khara is passionate about learning and regularly attends continuing education courses to broaden her knowledge of new innovations in dentistry and to stay up to date with the newest minimally invasive techniques available to treat dental disease. When not in the office, Dr. Khara enjoys reading, traveling to new places, baking and cake decorating and spending time with her husband and two children. Read More

blocks.heading: Dr. Vinh Nguyen
blocks.text: As a dentist, I believe that you should always treat each and every patient like they are your family because that is how I would like to be treated as well. Dentistry has allowed me to make a difference in thousands of people’s lives. The satisfaction of helping someone in pain or fixing their smile never gets old. One of my other goals as a dentist is to provide oral health services on mission trips. Being able to help those less fortunate gives me great fulfillment. I look forward to continuing existing relationships and forging new ones in the future. I grew up in Houston, TX and my family still lives there. I attended the University of Texas at Austin and earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Biology. Afterwards, I continued my education at Baylor College School of Dentistry where I received my DDS degree. I provide family and cosmetic dentistry and orthodontic services. I currently live in Plano, TX with my wife, Hong. We just recently got married in October 2014. Outside of work, my passions are food, cooking and traveling. I love trying anything new and am always looking for new places to explore Read More

blocks.heading: Dr. Jean Sanders
blocks.text: Dr. Jean Sanders grew up in western Kansas and earned her D.D.S. degree from Northwestern University in Chicago, Illinois. Since graduating, she practiced in Chicago and the Dallas area, both in the private practice setting as well as in the public health setting. Dr. Sanders enjoys providing all types of dental services to the entire family. She offers nitrous oxide (laughing gas) and sedation for patients who are nervous or worried during dental procedures. Her goal as a dentist is to provide everyone with maximum aesthetics and comfort in every dental procedure. Dr. Sanders hobbies are gardening, healthy cooking and spending time with her family.

blocks.heading: Dr. Natalie N. Simpson
blocks.text: Dr. Natalie N. Stimpson is a native of Dallas, Texas. She received her Bachelor’s degree in communication from Saint Edward’s University in Austin, Texas and in 2008, Dr. Stimpson earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery from the real “HU”, Howard University College Dentistry located in Washington, DC. Upon obtaining her Doctoral of Dental Surgery, Dr. Stimpson completed a general practice residency at St. Elizabeths Hospital in Washington, DC. While in residency she gained profound experience in rotary endodontics, extractions, restorative procedures as well as treating various patient populations. She also has continuing education training in Orthodontics and Implants. After completing her residency in Washington, DC, Dr. Stimpson was determined to return back home to Dallas to start providing and treating the community where she grew up. Dr. Stimpson returned to Dallas to follow her father’s entreprenerurial footsteps to service and provide treatment for communities in need of dental care and oral education. Dr. Stimpson was a taught at a young age about caring for community and providing service for those in need. Her parents, who were both pharmacists in DFW area, made it a point to teach their daughters the importance of community service and to be the best person you can be. With her upbringing and education, Dr. Stimpson found her calling in the medical field as a dentist. Read More

blocks.heading: Dr. Paul Choi
blocks.text: Dr. Paul Choi attended The University of Washington in Seattle and graduated with his Bachelor’s Degree in Biochemistry. He went on to attend Nova Southeastern University in Florida, where he earned his Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) degree. Dr. Choi has received extensive training in complex procedures, including wisdom tooth removal, root canal treatment, implant placement, and conscious oral sedation. Dr. Choi was introduced to dentistry by a family friend and was really drawn to the unique opportunity to build long-term relationships with patients and their families while caring for their oral health. He enjoys being able to offer a wide variety of procedures in one convenient location. Away from the office, Dr. Choi enjoys camping, fishing, hiking, and skiing. He is an avid fan of the Washington Huskies. Read More

blocks.heading: What is Accutane
blocks.text: The active component of this medicine is called isotretinoin. It is a derivative of vitamin A that is transformed into this vital compound inside the body. Retinoids are crucial for the skin condition and they help to reduce the amount of produced facial oil. At the same time, this medicine has certain side effects. Therefore, its intake requires an individual approach and control. It is recommended mainly in severe cases when other means are ineffective.
